summary: Quiet residential kerb with cars parked; homes 11-15 m away on this side.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb on both sides, 11-16 m away on this side; no gap in dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Open residential street with kerbside parking; cars already parked along it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street; a collector road meets it at the east end.
drivers.convention: Other cars park here; sign is 2P weekdays 9am-5pm only.

flags: Low-lying: min elevation about 31 m, Witton Creek 144 m away is not a concern
sun_shade: Open kerb with patchy tree shade from the south side; sun from both east and west.

best_section.where: Goldieslie Road north kerb, between the two mid-street driveways
